title: Bt toxin action
back: Inactive in the bacterium; activated only in the insect gut. Kills lepidopterans, coleopterans, dipterans.

title: cry genes
back: Cotton cries twice, corn cries once. Bt toxins are insect-group specific.

title: RNAi in tobacco
back: Against Meloidogyne incognita; genes delivered by Agrobacterium. RNAi is a natural eukaryotic defence.

title: Insulin structure
back: A and B chains joined by disulphide bridges; pro-insulin has a C peptide that is removed. Humulin: Eli Lilly, 1983.

title: Recombinant insulin
tex: \begin{gathered}A\text{ gene},\ B\text{ gene}\\\xrightarrow{E.\ coli} A,\ B\text{ chains}\\\xrightarrow{S-S} \text{insulin}\end{gathered}
back: Animal insulin (cattle, pig) caused allergy. The recombinant route skips the C peptide.

title: ADA gene therapy
back: 1990, 4-year-old girl. Periodic infusions needed; early-embryo gene transfer could be permanent.

title: PCR vs probe vs ELISA
back: All detect disease before symptoms or high pathogen counts. PCR finds HIV early.

title: Transgenic animal uses
back: Over 95% are mice. Rosie (1997): milk with human α-lactalbumin, 2.4 g/L. α-1-antitrypsin for emphysema.

title: Biopiracy
back: Turmeric and neem were also targeted. India's Patents Bill (second amendment) addresses this; GEAC handles GMO safety.

title: Bt toxin action
back: Protoxin crystal (inactive) → alkaline insect gut → active toxin → pores in midgut cells → swelling and lysis.

title: RNAi in tobacco
back: Sense + antisense RNA → dsRNA → RNAi silences the nematode's mRNA → Meloidogyne incognita cannot survive.
